manifest.name: dsh-secret-ask
manifest.description: Agent-asked secrets for DeepSeek Harness: a masked card stores API keys and tokens in the local credential store without them entering the chat, then injects them into one command.
manifest.author: zayyehtut (https://github.com/zayyehtut)

bundle.text:
- insert:
    - id: secret-ask
      name: 'dsh-secret-ask'
      config:
        entryMode: card

readme.text: Your agent needs an API key, token or password. Instead of asking you to paste it into the chat, it calls `ask_secret` and a **masked card** appears in the conversation. You type the value once; it goes straight into the local credential store through a loopback request and **never appears in the message, the model's context, or the session log**. Later the agent can run one command with that secret injected as an environment variable.

[](LICENSE)
[](https://github.com/zayyehtut/dsh-secret-ask/releases)
[](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

<sub>*Illustration with example data — not a live screenshot.*</sub>

- **A masked card instead of a chat paste** — a password field with an eye reveal toggle. The typed value lives only in that card's React state and is cleared when the card unmounts.
- **Three small tools** — `ask_secret` (ask and store), `run_with_secret` (use it for one command), `forget_secret` (remove it). The model only ever sees the secret's **name** and whether it is configured.
- **One-command injection** — the value is added as an environment variable to that one child process only, and exact value matches in the command output are replaced with `***`.
- **Cancel is clean** — "Not now" reports a cancelled request and stores nothing. No partial value, no draft.
- **Plain files, no build step** — the bundle is ESM JavaScript and the client half is a single React card. Nothing is compiled.

```
agent  ask_secret(name, purpose)
   │
   ├─ masked card in the conversation   (value stays in the card, in memory)
   │      │  POST /api/secret-ask  (loopback only, custom header, 64 KiB cap)

1. Open **Plugins** in the left sidebar.
2. Click **Add plugin**, paste this into the package field:

```
   github:zayyehtut/dsh-secret-ask
   ```

3. Click **Install**, then **Enable now**.
4. Reload the window once so the client half (the card) is loaded.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:zayyehtut/dsh-secret-ask
```

Restart `dsh web` afterwards. Replace `web` with your profile name if you use a custom one.

> Using the DeepSeek Harness desktop app? Use Option 1. The desktop app manages its own profile, so a CLI install into `profiles/web` will not show up there.

The plugin is submitted to the community **dsh-market** catalog. Once it appears there, search for **Secret Ask** and install it with one click.
Manual profile setup (for development) 1. Clone the repository anywhere on the machine: ```sh git clone https://github.com/zayyehtut/dsh-secret-ask.git ``` 2. In your DSH profile's `package.json`, add the package as a linked dependency and to the bundle list:

| Requirement | Check |
|---|---|
| DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1 or newer** (tested on `0.2.1-rc.5`) | `dsh --version` or the About dialog |
| A profile that includes the Web UI | The desktop app, or `dsh web` |
| Nothing else — no CLI, no token, no extra service | The credential store ships with the base composition |

1. Ask for something that needs a secret, for example: *"Publish this with my GitHub token."*
2. The agent calls `ask_secret`; a card titled **Secret requested** appears with the variable name and a one-line purpose.
3. Paste the value, press **Save** (or Enter). The card confirms, the agent continues — nothing is echoed into the transcript.
4. The agent now calls `run_with_secret` when it needs the value, for example a command that reads `$env:GITHUB_TOKEN`.
If the request already has a stored value, `ask_secret` is a no-op unless the agent asks with `replace: true`.

| Tool | What it does | What the model sees |
|---|---|---|
| `ask_secret` | Asks you for a named secret and stores it. No-op when already configured unless `replace: true`. | the name + a configured flag |
| `run_with_secret` | Runs a PowerShell command with named secrets as environment variables for that process only. | redacted output + exit code |
| `forget_secret` | Removes a stored secret by name. | the name + a configured flag |
Calls that need a secret fail with a clear `not configured: NAME` error, which tells the agent to call `ask_secret` first.

The bundle inserts one row with card mode on. To change it, add a matching patch to your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: secret-ask
  config:
    entryMode: card        # card = masked card (default); question = stock question card
    timeoutMs: 600000      # how long the card may wait, in ms; capped at 1 hour

- **`entryMode: question`** uses the stock question card instead of the masked card. It stores the same way, but the stock card keeps a draft in the Web UI, so **card mode is recommended**.
- **`enabled: false`** is a staged-install switch: the row mounts and registers nothing.

- **The value never enters the model's context.** Tool arguments and results carry names only; the card's submit request carries the value directly to the local process.
- **The submit route is local and narrow.** `/api/secret-ask` accepts loopback POSTs only, requires the `x-dsh-secret-ask: 1` header, checks the same origin, caps the body at 64 KiB, and never logs or echoes the value.
- **The card writes nothing to browser storage.** No `localStorage`, no draft store, no conversation entry; the input is cleared on unmount and after submit.
- **Redaction is exact-match best effort.** Output is scanned for the exact stored value (4+ characters) and replaced with `***`; a command that transforms or encodes the secret can still print the result.
- **Same-user access is discretion, not a boundary.** The credential file is readable by any program running as your Windows user — the same limitation the Harness documents for its own credential store. Do not treat this plugin as an isolation sandbox.
- **No background jobs and no sandbox escalation.** `run_with_secret` runs one command under the normal sandbox policy; it cannot keep a process alive after the tool returns.

| Symptom | Fix |
|---|---|
| The card never appears and the tool waits | The page was open before the plugin loaded. Reload the window; or set `entryMode: question` and let the agent ask again. |
| "No value was entered before the request timed out" | The card waited 10 minutes (default). Reload the window, then call the tool again. |
| `not configured: GITHUB_TOKEN` | The agent must call `ask_secret` for that name before `run_with_secret`. |
| The output shows `***` | That is the redaction working — the exact value is never returned to the model. |
| A secret leaks in a transformed form | Redaction only matches the exact stored value. Avoid commands that encode or re-format the secret. |
| Install succeeded but nothing registers | Confirm the bundle is enabled on the Plugins page and your DSH is 0.2.1 or newer. |

- **DeepSeek Harness:** 0.2.1 or newer; developed and tested against `0.2.1-rc.5`.
- **Profiles:** any profile with the Web UI (desktop app, `dsh web`). The card is plain web UI.
- **Platforms:** Windows 10/11 tested end to end. The mechanics are platform-neutral; macOS and Linux are untested.

There is no build step: the bundle is plain ESM JavaScript.

```
index.js           Host half — tools, the masked card's loopback route, credential store calls
client.js          Client half — the masked card (React) registered as the ask_secret tool view
cordis.patch.yml   The DSH bundle patch that inserts the plugin row (card mode)
icon.svg           Source icon

Regenerate the art from code (requires Pillow):

```sh
python tools/make-preview.py   # rewrites assets/preview.png
python tools/make-icon.py      # rewrites assets/icon-180.png
```

Link the repository into a DSH profile as shown under *Manual profile setup*, reload the window, and the card shows up on the next `ask_secret`. Client edits need a window reload; host edits need the plugin re-enabled or the app restarted.
